consumer: The door's NPC dialogue gate (a dialogue possession check) asking: is the id_card carried on the player's body right now?
scope: On-person only (worn/wielded/held inventory), NOT the reachable/nearby crafting inventory
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — tests u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item, count), i.e. find-item mission completeness over the reachable crafting inventory, a predicate of the wrong reach
divergence: The id_card lies in an adjacent locker/on the ground within crafting reach but is not worn or held; crafting_inventory().has_amount returns true (mission complete) while the on-person dialogue possession check must return false
